EN: American Roulette features a wheel with 38 pockets, numbered from 0 to 36 with an additional '00' slot. Here's how you can place your bets:  Single Numbers: Bet on any single number from 0 to 36 and 00. Payout is 35 to 1. Split: Place your chip on the line between any two numbers, including 0 and 00. Covers both numbers. Payout is 17 to 1. Street: Bet on three consecutive numbers by placing your chip on the boundary line of the roulette table at the end of the corresponding row. Includes the 0 and 00 rows. Payout is 11 to 1. Corner: Place your chip at the corner where four numbers meet, including the intersections involving 0 and 00. All four numbers are covered. Payout is 8 to 1. Basket: Bet on 0, 00, 1, 2, and 3 by placing a chip on the corner shared by the first line and the 0 and 00 boxes. Payout is 6 to 1. Top Line: Bet on 0, 00, 1, 2, and 3. Payout is 6 to 1. Six Line: Bet on two adjoining streets, placing the chip on the corresponding intersection, also including 0 and 00. Payout is 5 to 1. Columns: Choose from one of the three columns of numbers on the table. Each covers 12 numbers. Payout is 2 to 1. Dozens: Bet on one of the three dozen found on the layout of the table: 1st 12, 2nd 12, 3rd 12. Payout is 2 to 1. Even/Odd: Bet on all even numbers or all odd numbers. Does not include 0 or 00. Payout is 1 to 1. Red/Black: Bet on either all red numbers or all black numbers. Does not include 0 or 00. Payout is 1 to 1. High/Low: Bet on either low (1-18) or high (19-36) numbers. Does not include 0 or 00. Payout is 1 to 1.

原文: 百家樂遊戲步驟和投注選項：  發牌：莊家和閒家各發兩張牌。 閒家規則：閒家首兩張牌點數總和為0-5時，需要再抓一張牌。如果是6或7，閒家停牌。 莊家規則：莊家是否抓牌遵循一套更複雜的規則，這取決於閒家的牌和莊家的初始點數。 賠率： 閒家贏：賠率為1:1。 莊家贏：賠率為0.95:1（向賭場支付5%的傭金）。 和局：通常賠率為8:1。
EN: Baccarat Game Steps and Betting Options:  Deal: Two cards are dealt to both the Player and the Banker. Player's Rule: If the Player has an initial total of 0-5, they draw a third card. If the total is 6 or 7, they stand. Banker's Rule: Banker draws a third card based on a more complicated set of rules, which depends on the Player's cards and Banker's initial total. Outcomes: Player Wins: Pays 1:1. Banker Wins: Pays 0.95:1 (5% commission to the house). Tie: Typically pays 8:1.
JA: バカラのゲーム手順とベッティングオプション：  ディール：プレイヤーとバンカーの両方に2枚のカードが配られます。 プレイヤーのルール：プレイヤーの初期合計が0-5の場合、第三カードを引きます。合計が6または7の場合、スタンドします。 バンカーのルール：バンカーはもう少し複雑な一連のルールに基づいて第三カードを引きます。これはプレイヤーのカードとバンカーの初期合計に依存します。 結果： プレイヤー勝利：1:1で支払われます。 バンカー勝利：0.95:1で支払われます（5％の手数料が家に行きます）。 タイ：通常は8:1で支払われます。

EN: Dragon Tiger Game Steps and Betting Options:  Deal: One card each is dealt to the Dragon and the Tiger. EN: Big and Small Game Overview:  Gameplay: Players bet on the total of three dice being "Small" (4-10) or "Big" (11-17). Rules: Three dice are rolled. KO: 빅 앤드 스몰 게임 개요:  게임플레이: 플레이어는 세 개의 주사위 합계가 "스몰"(4-10) 또는 "빅"(11-17)이 될 것인지에 대해 베팅합니다. 규칙: 세 개의 주사위가 굴러갑니다. 합계가 베팅 범위 내에 있으면 플레이어가 승리합니다. 지급률: 승리 베팅은 일반적으로 1:1로 지급됩니다. 주의: 3 또는 18의 합계는 일반적으로 베팅 옵션에 포함되지 않으며 베팅이 패배합니다.
SC: 大小游戏概览：  游戏玩法：玩家押注三个骰子的点数总和为“小”（4-10点）或“大”（11-17点）。 规则：掷三个骰子。如果点数总和落在押注范围内，则玩家赢。 赔率：赢的赌注通常赔率为1:1。注意：3点或18点的总和通常不包括在投注选项中，押注将输。

EN: Odd or Even Game Overview:  Gameplay: Players bet on whether the total sum of the dice rolled will be odd or even. Rules: One or more dice are rolled. If the total matches the bet (odd or even), the player wins. Payouts: Winning bets usually pay 1:1.

SC: 丁半游戏概览：  游戏玩法: 玩家押注掷出的骰子点数总和是奇数还是偶数。 规则: 掷一枚或多枚骰子。如果点数总和与押注（奇数或偶数）相匹配，玩家赢。 赔率: 赢的赌注通常赔率为1:1。

原文: 花旗骰遊戲概覽：  遊戲玩法: 玩家押注兩個骰子擲出的結果。 初始擲骰：投注輪的第一次擲骰。如果擲出7或11（自然點），押注「通行線」的玩家贏。如果擲出2、3或12（爛點），「通行線」的押注輸。 點數階段：如果初始擲骰是4、5、6、8、9或10，該數字成為「點數」。擲骰手繼續擲骰，直到他們再次擲出點數（「通行線」押注贏）或擲出7（「通行線」押注輸）。 投注選項：包括通行線、不通行線、來、不來、賠率、位置、區域和各種命題投注。 賠率：根據押注的不同而變化，單次擲骰的賭注通常提供更高的賠率。
EN: Craps Game Overview:  Gameplay: Players bet on the outcome of the roll of two dice. Come Out Roll: The first roll of the dice in a betting round. If the roll is 7 or 11 (Natural), players betting the Pass line win. If the roll is 2, 3, or 12 (Craps), Pass line bets lose.
